title: Smoked Portuguese Potato Gratin
description: A gluten-free, smoked twist on a classic Portuguese potato gratin. This dish is perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Thinly slice the potatoes and layer them in the baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the grated cheese, smoked ashen, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Sprinkle the cheese mixture evenly over the potatoes.
Drizzle the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over the top of the potatoes.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown and the top is crispy.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
